purpose: Trusted one-time recertification cache. It preserves already-paid Ecosystem evidence but discards language-local legacy normalized scores, centrally re-adjudicates the retained findings under the frozen runner-owned v2 rubric, and lets the normal current validator prove the synthesized result before it can hydrate a leaf.
recertification_method: Preserve historical provider-brokered sources, candidate universes and findings as evidence.
Do not reuse the historical normalized score as authoritative.
Apply the current five-component rubric centrally and freeze integer evidence levels 0..4.
Let apply_ecosystem_runner_scores recompute every score and the ordinary current result validator accept or reject the synthesized result.
For Quidra, require the exact frozen compiler/runtime execution identity; a changed target falls back to a fresh current Ecosystem worker.
